_note: Download CSV (ADR 0110): every card (and the side-by-side table) can save the hourly table behind its answers for the card's mission period (the Mission check length, config/metrics.json default_period_days, starting at the card time). Built in the browser from the tables already loaded (Blob); no server, no request to another host. Column names are the file's schema (src/csv.js CSV_COLUMNS); the values below are what the cells say.
_note_name: File name = <file_prefix>_<site id>_<YYYY-MM-DD of the card time>_<days>d.csv; several cards are joined with _vs_. Longer names are cut at max_name_chars (before .csv).
_note_bom: A UTF-8 byte order mark at the start, so spreadsheet programs read the file as UTF-8 (site names, the degree sign).
